title: Cassandra
description:
Cassandra: CQL against the system keyspaces, with `consistency=ONE` in the URL. Needs
`make it-up` (port 19042, cassandra / cassandra). See `:help dbdash-databases`.

query.sql: SELECT cluster_name, release_version, cql_version, data_center, rack FROM system.local

show.title: system.local
show.description: The node's own row of `system.local`: cluster name, versions, data center and rack.

show.title: Keyspaces (system_schema)
show.description: Every keyspace and whether its writes are durable (`system_schema.keyspaces`).

query.transform:
-- Tables per keyspace (CQL has no GROUP BY across partitions here).
local count = {}
for _, r in ipairs(rs.rows) do count[r[1]] = (count[r[1]] or 0) + 1 end
local out = {}
for k, n in pairs(count) do out[#out + 1] = { keyspace = k, tables = n } end
table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a.tables > b.tables end)
return out

show.title: Tables per keyspace
show.description:
Tables per keyspace: CQL has no GROUP BY across partitions here, so
`query.transform` counts the rows of `system_schema.tables` in Lua.
